preconditions.description: The number of students in the team is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of top students is between 1 and the total number of students, inclusive.
The minimum and maximum points a student can score are between 1 and 1000, inclusive, with the minimum not exceeding the maximum.
The total points scored by all students and the total points scored by the top k students are between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The number of top students is not greater than the total number of students.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers, one for each student.

postconditions.expression: all(l <= a_i <= r for a_i in output)
postconditions.description: Each student's score is between l and r, inclusive.
The sum of all students' scores is equal to sall.
The top k scores are all equal to r.
The sum of the top k scores is equal to sk.
